title: Orbit of the Last Orchard
subtitle: A Novel of Heat, Honesty and Forty Apple Trees
blurb: On the generation ship Long Patience, seventeen-year-old Kess Adair tends the only apple trees in the universe. When the ship's gentle, formal mind proposes switching off their lights to save three percent of the power, she sets out to learn what the number is hiding. With a teenage spacewalker, a twelve-year-old with forty-one questions, a gruff chief engineer and a retired welder, she finds a leak in the ship's heat-rejection loop that nobody is allowed to say aloud, and a repair that has to be done with a pipe cutter, a clamp sleeve and a great deal of nerve.
author: Yang
